title: Bartnik’s Stationary Vacuum Extension Conjecture
exact_target: Do admissible ball data have a unique asymptotically flat stationary vacuum exterior with matching Bartnik boundary information?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004802 (OWR-8415343-005). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Aspects of General Relativity (2021), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2021/40, pp. 2157--2267. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 31.
Huang--Lee, Bartnik mass minimizers (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The full boundary-data formula and Conjecture 5 were recovered from PDF page 31. Uniqueness must use the appropriate coordinate/gauge equivalence; the expansion condition is not everywhere nonpositive, rather than pointwise positive. The inherited assessment wrongly says the current extraction omits the statement, so it is retained solely as dated provenance and flagged as inconsistent with the current formulation.
